Name: Laundry Machines
Author: fireredlily
Description:
[size=4][b]Want Another Way to Obtain Clothing Items?
[/b][/size]Now introducing new Laundry Machine sets, sold by Robin. Laundry Machines are furniture items that can be placed indoors or outdoors, and will produce one random piece of clothing or Cloth per day. This includes special shirts or pants that would normally not be obtainable outside of specific circumstances.

The basic non-animated sprite is from HxW Tilesheets and has been used with permission to create these machines for functional furniture.

[size=3][b]How does it work?
[/b][/size]Once you have placed down a Laundry Machine, it will start the animated spin cycle and automatically produce a random Clothing item or Cloth the next day! The Laundry Machine must be emptied of its produced item to begin producing the next day's item.

[b][size=3]But now I have too many clothes![/size]
[/b]This mod also adds the ability to recycle your extra clothing or hats back into Cloth, using the Recycling Machine from the base game!

[b]Why does this mod need multiple dependencies? What do they do?[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Extra Machine Configs is the framework that allows clothing to come out of the Laundry Machines, or be used as an input to be recycled![/size]
[*][size=2]Furniture Machine allows the Laundry Machines to be animated when they are working.[/size]
[*][size=2]HxW Tilesheets provides the basic non-animated Laundry Machine sprite as part of their Bathroom Furniture collection.[/size]
[*][size=2]Content Patcher is required to edit the machine rules and add the new machines as furniture items in-game.[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Adds functional furniture Laundry Machines to Robin's shop that will produce one Clothing item or Cloth per day. Also allows Recycling Machines to recycle Hats or Clothing items into Cloth.
